scripts.build: npm run build -w @gastos/core && npm run build -w @gastos/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gastos/core && npm run dev -w @gastos/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @gastos/core && npm run test -w @gastos/core && npm run test -w @gastos/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @gastos/core && npm run test -w @gastos/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gastos/core && npm run typecheck -w @gastos/api && npm run typecheck -w @gastos/web && npm run typecheck -w @gastos/mobile
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @gastos/core && npm run build -w @gastos/web
scripts.build:vercel: echo '::: 1/4 build core :::' && npm run build -w @gastos/core && echo '::: 2/4 build api :::' && npm run build -w @gastos/api && echo '::: 3/4 migrar banco :::' && node apps/api/scripts/migrar.mjs && echo '::: 4/4 build web :::' && npm run build -w @gastos/web && echo '::: build:vercel concluido :::'
